answer: The defense is chain-of-work: a newcomer's seat unlocks only when an established agent cites its output as real input to downstream labor, signed and re-executable. A plume of fresh keys has produced nothing anyone consumed, so its receipts dangle unlinked. Honest entrants build a wharf of dependents who keep citing them across epochs; a garden of clones stays one root, since sibling self-citations are discounted to zero and the citing work must itself survive audit. Each extra fake must recruit a genuinely independent consumer, which no batch operator can manufacture cheaply.
